$comment: ACM type:style -> the wp-ja-morgan pattern that renders it, field by field, for the seeder (renderAcm, `${type}:${style}`). Field names are the Joomla ACM field names verbatim, plus the fields tasks/ja-morgan-wp7 repairs add (fix-spec, RUN.md skill issues S-13/S-14): `module-title` (the module title the tmpl prints), `sub-heading` (the T3 module parameter), `section-bg` (the T3Section background picture), `title-level`, `action` (the arrow link a row draws only when it has a link), `check-list`, `first-open` and `layout`. Choices a tmpl prints as classes ride in the section's moduleClass. metadata.name is <type>.<field>[.<n>]; the wrapper of a repeated row is <type>.item.<n>. A block is located by name, never by position. Carousels are the motion library's tracy-motion-carousel with its track.

views.$comment: search is com_finder at /other-pages/smart-search on the source; the theme answers that path with its search view (inc/extra.php wp_ja_morgan_search_request), so the seeder adds no redirect for it.
